title: The Grumbling Vault
description: Deep beneath the Aelerian foothills, a sealed chamber holds the Keystone of Unmaking – a fist-sized chunk of obsidian that can destabilize any ward within a mile. The Aeler locked it away centuries ago, but the wards have grown senile. They tick and pulse like a failing heart. Your goal: retrieve the keystone for a bitter old drunk who claims it's owed to him. By his beard, you'll earn every coin.
author: Nicholas A. Gasper

bestiary.name: Iron Wraith
bestiary.description: A towering suit of Aelerian armor, animated by ancient grudges. It moves with a grinding, clockwork precision, and its joints weep rust. It's resistant to magic – spells slide off its plates like water off a duck's back. Best to hit it with something heavy.

sb_spends.name: Sundering Bash
sb_spends.effect: The Wraith shatters a piece of cover or equipment; a PC loses one Minor Asset until repaired.

sb_spends.name: Rust Cloud
sb_spends.effect: The Wraith shakes itself, releasing a cloud of rust; all in Near range must test Body+Endurance or gain 1 Fatigue.

bestiary.lore: The Aeler didn't just build guards – they built accountants of violence. Each Wraith was once a Spirit Shield warrior, bound to the armor after death to continue their duty. They don't remember their names, but they remember their oaths.

bestiary.name: Rune Wisp
bestiary.description: A flickering, cackling ball of magical energy that escaped a broken ward. It's not intelligent – just hungry for attention. And light. And your eyebrows.

sb_spends.name: Flash of Light
sb_spends.effect: A PC is Blinded for one exchange (all actions at Desperate).

bestiary.name: Ward-Primus
bestiary.description: The vault's ultimate guardian – a crackling humanoid shape of living runes and stored arcane energy. It is immune to magic; spells simply feed it. Only cold steel, a well-aimed hammer, or a clever word can stop it.

sb_spends.name: Absorb Magic
sb_spends.effect: The Primus negates the next spell cast and heals 2 Harm.

sb_spends.name: Force Burst
sb_spends.effect: All in Near range take Harm 2; Body+Endurance DV 4 halves.

sb_spends.name: Rune Lock
sb_spends.effect: The Primus seals a door or passage, trapping a PC away from the group.

bestiary.lore: The Primus was not built to fight – it was built to enforce the vault's internal laws. It doesn't hate you; it simply cannot allow you to leave with what is not yours. It can be reasoned with, if you offer it something it values more than the keystone – like a fresh memory of a sunrise, or a promise to destroy a rival's ward elsewhere.

acts.title: The Grumbling Vault
acts.description: Three chambers. One grumpy dwarf. A timer that ticks with every spell. Let's do this.

scenes.title: Chamber 1: The Sealed Door
scenes.description: A massive bronze door, etched with Aeler runes that pulse faintly. No handle. No keyhole. Durin belches. The door hums with ancient power – and it's hungry for a reaction.

timers.name: Ward Resonance
timers.description: Every spell or rite ticks this up. When full, the Ward-Primus awakens.

timers.name: Durin's Debt
timers.description: Each time you use Durin's advice, tick this. When full, he demands his 'trinket'.

outcomes.clean: You open the door without using magic. Ward Resonance does not advance.
outcomes.partial: You open it, but a Rune Wisp escapes. Tick Ward Resonance +1.
outcomes.miss: The door resists. Tick Ward Resonance +2 and trigger the alarm.

outcomes.clean: Durin grumbles about a pressure plate under the third stone. You find a crawl space. No magic needed.
outcomes.partial: He gives you a vague hint – but you waste time. Tick Durin's Debt +1.
outcomes.miss: He falls asleep. You're on your own.

scenes.title: Chamber 2: The Hall of Sundered Oaths
scenes.description: A long hall lined with suits of animated Aeler armor – three Iron Wraiths. They do not move until a spell is cast or a loud noise is made. They are resistant to magic, but vulnerable to being sundered.

outcomes.clean: You destroy the Wraiths without triggering the timer. Tick Ward Resonance -1 for each successful sunder.
outcomes.partial: You destroy them, but one explodes in a rust cloud – all in Near take 1 Fatigue.
outcomes.miss: The Wraiths counterattack. Tick Ward Resonance +2 and take Harm 1.

scenes.title: Chamber 3: The Heart of Silence
scenes.description: A domed chamber. The Keystone of Unmaking floats above a black altar. Four pillars pulse with light. The Ward Resonance Timer is visible as a glowing ring around the keystone. If the timer fills, the Ward-Primus rises.

outcomes.clean: You snatch the keystone without awakening the Primus. Success.
outcomes.partial: You grab it, but you trigger a minor ward. Tick Ward Resonance +1.

outcomes.clean: You defeat the Primus. The keystone is yours.
outcomes.partial: You defeat it, but it explodes – all in Near take Harm 2.
outcomes.miss: The Primus overwhelms you. You must flee.

npcs.name: Durin Stoneshield
npcs.motivation: Get the keystone to settle an old debt – or just to have something to complain about.
npcs.secret: He was never an Iron Avenger. He was a cook. But he tells a good story, and that's what matters.

locations.name: The Sealed Door
locations.description: A massive bronze door, etched with Aeler runes that pulse faintly. No handle. No keyhole. The runes seem to watch you.

locations.name: The Hall of Sundered Oaths
locations.description: A long hall lined with suits of animated Aeler armor. The air is thick with the memory of broken promises.

locations.name: The Heart of Silence
locations.description: A domed chamber where the Keystone of Unmaking floats above a black altar. The walls pulse with stored energy.

factions.name: The Aeler Vault Guardians
factions.goals: Protect the keystone at all costs, even if their wards are senile.
factions.relationship: The guardians are remnants of a long-dead order. They don't negotiate – they just enforce.

campaignTimers.name: Ward Resonance
campaignTimers.description: Each spell, rite, or magical action ticks this up. When full, the Ward-Primus awakens.

campaignTimers.name: Durin's Debt
campaignTimers.description: Each time you rely on Durin's advice, tick this. When full, he demands his 'trinket' – a rusty belt buckle.

notes: This is a classic dungeon crawl with a twist: magic is actively punished. The Ward Resonance Timer forces players to think about whether to use spells or rely on muscle and wits. Durin is a comic relief NPC whose advice is half-true – players who fact-check him gain an edge. The final boss (Ward-Primus) is immune to magic, so melee characters get a chance to shine. Designed for a single session of 3–4 hours.
